verdict.rationale: Justworks explicitly markets 'built-in payroll... and automated tax filings' and collects W-4/withholding info automatically, indicating tax calculation and filing is handled as part of PEO payroll. However, evidence lacks detail on the specific federal/state/local scope, remittance mechanics, or independent verification of accuracy/coverage across all jurisdictions. Missing for 10: detailed documentation on state/local tax registration handling, remittance process specifics, and third-party/hands-on confirmation of compliance accuracy.
